name: HEP Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: HEP Tech Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise that specializes in the production and distribution of electronic lighting control systems for both industrial and commercial applications. The company's comprehensive product line features a wide range of LED drivers, including cutting-edge wireless control models, constant current (CC) drivers designed for track lighting (available in both dimmable and non-dimmable versions), and constant voltage (CV) drivers (also offered as dimmable or non-dimmable units). Additionally, they supply specialized LED drivers with PSE and UL certifications, alongside solutions tailored for floodlights and outdoor environments, complemented by various accessories. Beyond drivers, HEP Tech provides complete track lighting systems and associated luminaires such as UV lights, spotlights, modeling lamps, and audio-integrated products. Their offerings also extend to electronic control gear (ECG) for fluorescent, HID, and HPS lighting, as well as essential emergency lighting products. The company's expertise covers a broad spectrum of lighting needs, from general indoor and outdoor illumination to commercial spaces, exhibition displays, and artistic lighting installations. Furthermore, HEP Tech diversifies its business by distributing automotive aftermarket components and bicycles. Established in 1991, the company's headquarters are situated in Taichung, Taiwan.
